providerTouchWindowDays.description: Provider link, QR, desk, widget or provider-owned deep link counts for this many days. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 30.

patientReferralWindowDays.description: Patient referral click to registration or booking. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 30.

campaignClickWindowDays.description: Paid or owned campaign click. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 7.

visitorKeyMaxDays.description: Cap on the consent-gated visitor key lifetime. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 180.

newPatientLookbackMonths.description: Mirror of Market.featureDefaults.newPatient.lookbackMonths; informational here, the Clinic rule is authoritative. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 24.

touchEvidenceRetentionMonths.description: Raw touches linked to a decision are kept this long. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 25.

unlinkedTouchRetentionMonths.description: Touches not linked to any decision are kept this long. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 13.

minDwellMsForProviderTouch.description: A provider touch counts only if the landing page was actually rendered this long. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 1000.

ltTokenTtlMinutes.description: Lifetime of the signed in-session link token. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 30.

precedence.description: Commission precedence. FIRST_TOUCH is reporting only and is rejected for commission use by the decision function. PROPOSED_DEFAULT PROVIDER_FIRST.

allowOfflineEvidence.description: An OFFLINE source recorded by staff before check-in may make a decision PROVIDER_LED. PROPOSED_DEFAULT False.

ltBinding.description: Added in 1.12.0 (optional). SESSION_HASH binds the link-touch token to a hash of the first-seen session and refuses it elsewhere. Absent means NONE (behaviour unchanged). PROPOSED_DEFAULT NONE.

approvalAboveMinor.description: A campaign whose total budget is above this (minor units) needs a second approver to activate. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 2000000 (EGP 20,000).

budgetIncreaseApprovalPercent.description: A budget increase above this percent of the approved budget needs a BUDGET_INCREASE approval. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 20.

monthlyCeilingMinor.description: Per-market monthly ceiling over all ACTIVE and SCHEDULED campaigns (planned budget). PROPOSED_DEFAULT 50000000.

dailyDefaultCapMinor.description: Daily cap suggested for a new campaign. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 1000000.

budgetAlertThresholdsBp.description: Utilisation alerts in basis points of the total budget. 10000 auto-pauses (PAUSED BUDGET). PROPOSED_DEFAULT [5000, 8000, 10000].

allowedChannels.description: Channels a campaign may list. Paid channels are plan labels only.

sensitiveChannels.description: A campaign listing any of these always needs a second approver. PROPOSED_DEFAULT [WHATSAPP, SMS].

campaignPrefixMarket.description: utm_campaign is <market lower case>-<key>. PROPOSED_DEFAULT true.

allowedHttpsHosts.description: https creative references must be on one of these hosts (exact match).

assetKeyPrefix.description: Object-store prefix for uploaded creatives. PROPOSED_DEFAULT growth/creatives/.

autoExpiryGraceHours.description: Grace after endsAt before the job completes an ACTIVE campaign. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 0.

requireReasonOnPause.description: A manual pause needs a reason code. PROPOSED_DEFAULT true.

regimeId.description: Consent regime id, e.g. pdpl-eg-v0 (counsel NEEDS_HUMAN).

maxMarketingPerDay.description: Frequency cap across channels (Phase 2 enforcement). PROPOSED_DEFAULT 1.

maxMarketingPerWeek.description: Frequency cap across channels (Phase 2 enforcement). PROPOSED_DEFAULT 3.

withdrawalPropagationSeconds.description: Withdrawal must reach the send gate within this many seconds. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 60.

bannerEqualWeight.description: Accept and Reject carry equal weight; no pre-ticked boxes. Not switchable.

textVersionIds.description: Ids of the approved wording; TODO_NEEDS_HUMAN_v0 until counsel approves.

enabled.description: Master switch of the rule set (the launch-locked flag growth.corporate still decides whether anything runs).

openCode.description: A code usable by anyone who holds it (up to its redemption cap).

domainEmail.description: Eligibility by the domain of a verified Passport e-mail claim. Never an unverified address.

hrList.description: Eligibility by a two-person-approved HR list (keyed hashes only, deleted after the matching window).

fundingMode.description: SPONSOR_CREDIT: the corporate funds a ceiling in its own separate benefit ledger. PLATFORM_PROMO: Kiorex funds it as a marketing expense (counsel and CFO decide).

minAggregateK.description: Smallest group an employer or ops report may show. The floor 10 is a safety control, not a preference.

length.description: Characters of the Crockford base32 code (no I, L, O, U). PROPOSED_DEFAULT 10.

groupSize.description: Display grouping with a hyphen; 0 = none. Hyphens and spaces are ignored on input.

matchWindowDays.description: Days an approved list can be matched; after that its hashed rows are deleted. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 30 (privacy, counsel to confirm).

maxRows.description: Largest list one upload may carry.

propertyNames.description: Integration kind: googleads, searchconsole, ga4, playconsole, appstoreconnect, metaads, tiktok, whatsappcloud, fcmapns, crux or a kind added later.

mode.description: PROPOSED_DEFAULT mock. real is never exercised in CI.

secretRef.description: NAME of a secret in the secrets store, never the value.

accountLabel.description: Display label of the account (never an id or a secret).

integrations.description: Settings per integration kind, keyed by kind. One version covers every integration of the scope; the platform flag growth.integrations.<kind> still switches each one.

messageClasses.description: Fixed set: TRANSACTIONAL, SECURITY, CLINICAL, MARKETING (AD-6).

attributes.description: Allowlisted non-clinical attributes only: never a specialty, provider or health attribute.

holdoutBps.description: Share of eligible people kept out of non-essential journeys for measurement, in basis points. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 0.

canonicalSegment.description: URL segment, lowercase cc, e.g. eg.

bookingLinkBaseUrl.description: Provider link host, e.g. https://kiorly.link (NEEDS_HUMAN, NH-008).

qrEnabled.description: Provider QR codes and posters on/off for this market. PROPOSED_DEFAULT True.

marketingLicenceConfirmed.description: Counsel confirmed the direct-marketing licence position for this market. PROPOSED_DEFAULT false; growth.marketing_messaging stays launch-locked regardless.

whatsappPhoneNumberIdRef.description: secretRef or config name of the WhatsApp phone number id; never the value.

integrations.description: Integration kind -> on/off; feature switches themselves stay in the flag control plane.

geographyListRef.description: Reference to the market-pack district list (NH-040/FD-14 open).

dataCell.description: Data cell id, e.g. frankfurt; one cell today.

enabled.description: Master switch of the rule set (the launch-locked flag growth.patient_referral still decides whether anything runs).

requireAttended.description: The referred person must have an attended booking.

holdDays.description: Days after attendance before qualification (cancellation and fraud window). PROPOSED_DEFAULT 7.

requirePhoneVerified.description: Both sides must have a verified phone.

lookbackDays.description: Window from claim to first booking. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 30.

count.description: Extra rewards for repeat bookings; 0 turns it off. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 0.

eligibleCareTypes.description: Non-clinical buckets only. Never a specialty.

deviceSignal.description: Use a device signal in fraud checks. PROPOSED_DEFAULT false (privacy).

paymentFingerprint.description: Use the payment fingerprint. PROPOSED_DEFAULT true.

mode.description: PROPOSED_DEFAULT COUPON (lower regulatory exposure). CREDIT needs counsel clearance.

referrerMinor.description: PROPOSED_DEFAULT 0 until pricing sets a deposit or fee (AD-4).

ruleBudgetCeilingMinor.description: Total this rule version may issue.

redemptionMaxBp.description: Largest share of the deposit (basis points) a reward may pay. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 10000.

minPayableMinor.description: Smallest amount the patient must still pay by card. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 0.

postToPayLedger.description: Post redemptions to the pay ledger (balanced PROMO_FUNDED posting). PROPOSED_DEFAULT false (finance decision).

reversalWindowDays.description: A refund or cancellation of the qualifying booking inside this window reverses the reward. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 30.

holdMaxDays.description: A HOLD on a lot is released automatically after this many days without a decision. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 14.

manualApprovalAboveMinor.description: Manual issuance above this needs a second approver. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 20000.

manualDailyCapPerActorMinor.description: Manual issuance cap per actor per day. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 50000.

issueOn.description: Verified events an issuance may follow. SIGNUP and BOOKING_CREATED are not valid values (safety rule S4). PROPOSED_DEFAULT [COMPLETED_VISIT].

credit.description: PATIENT credit block (Rev 2.6, ADR-048 Proposed). Only meaningful in CREDIT mode behind the locked flags growth.patient_credit, growth.refund_as_credit and growth.family_credit.

maxOpenBalanceMinor.description: Maximum open balance per patient and per household. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 200000 (EGP 2,000), counsel to confirm.

refundCreditOnExpiry.description: PROPOSED_DEFAULT REFUND_TO_ORIGINAL: it is the patient's own money.

restoredLotMinDays.description: A credit restored after a refund keeps at least this many days. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 90.

specialtyAllowlist.description: Counsel-approved non-sensitive specialties where a campaign credit may be SPENT. A scope is never a targeting attribute.

canonicalHost.description: Absolute canonical origin, e.g. https://kiorex.com (NEEDS_HUMAN per environment).

minLiveProviders.description: Thin-page guard: LIVE providers with slots needed before a generated page is indexable. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 3.

minUniqueBlocks.description: Thin-page guard: data-derived content blocks needed. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 3.

maxSiblingSimilarityPercent.description: Thin-page guard: maximum provider-list overlap with a sibling page. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 70.

delistedGoneAfterDays.description: A DELISTED page answers 301 to the hub, then 410 after this many days when no hub exists. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 30.

reviewMarkupEnabled.description: Emit aggregateRating only from visible verified reviews. PROPOSED_DEFAULT True.

districtPagesEnabled.description: Generate district-level pages when they pass the guard. PROPOSED_DEFAULT True.

templates.description: Title and description templates per locale and page type (PROPOSED_DEFAULT: the built-in copy; Arabic needs CMO review). Placeholders: {name} {specialty} {city} {district} {country} {clinic} {count} {fees} {rating} {where} {care} {brand}; unknown placeholders, markup and unbalanced braces are rejected by the Kiorex write path. Additive in 1.11.0.

paginatedIndexable.description: Page 2 and beyond of a listing are indexable (self-canonical). PROPOSED_DEFAULT false: they are noindex,follow and not in sitemaps. Additive in 1.11.0.

reviewMarkupMinCount.description: Visible, verified reviews needed before Physician or Pharmacy pages emit aggregateRating. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 5. Additive in 1.11.0.

sameDayWindowHours.description: A provider is same day when its next slot starts within this many hours. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 24. Additive in 1.11.0.

minAvailableProviders.description: Same-day and telemedicine hubs need this many providers with real availability or declared video. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 2. Additive in 1.11.0.

maxParentSimilarityPercent.description: A district or city-hub page whose provider set overlaps its parent by more than this percent is noindex,follow (doorway rule). PROPOSED_DEFAULT 100. Additive in 1.11.0.

delistedStatus.description: Added in 1.12.0 (optional). Response for a delisted provider profile. Absent means 404 (today). PROPOSED_DEFAULT 404.

commissionBasis.description: GROSS_BEFORE_SPONSORED (default): the Kiorex fee is computed on the fee before any sponsored discount. NET_AFTER_SPONSORED exists for a future percentage model only.

highValueBudgetMinor.description: A promotion budget cap at or above this needs a second approver.

highValuePerBookingMinor.description: A per-booking discount at or above this needs a second approver.

maxDiscountBp.description: A percent discount above this needs a second approver. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 3000.

reservationTtlGraceMinutes.description: Reservation lives as long as the hold plus this grace.

reviewRequired.description: Every promotion version goes through the advertising review. PROPOSED_DEFAULT true; not switchable off in production.

fraudRuleWeights.description: Shadow-mode weights of the promotion fraud signals.

maxOriginsPerOrg.description: Exact https origins a provider may allow. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 10.

allowLocalhostOrigins.description: Allow http://localhost origins (non-production only; always false in production). PROPOSED_DEFAULT False.

maxActiveHoldsPerPhone.description: Slot hoarding limit per phone. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 3.

maxActiveHoldsPerIpHash.description: Slot hoarding limit per rotating IP hash. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 5.

sdkCacheSeconds.description: Cache lifetime of the immutable versioned sdk.js path. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 31536000.
